strategy:
Main Character Energy.

Commercial job: Hold conversion in the March trough, widen members' formats (one-format members renew at 58–67% vs 85–87% on 4+), and stop March expiries from waiting for April by giving them a reason to renew now.

Newcomer: The Second Date (“Your second class is booked before you leave. Decide fast, save 20%.”). Buyers by month-one return visits: 0 → 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%. The booked second class plus a closing window is the lever.

Newcomer: Earn the Lab (“Three classes in 14 days unlock the Strength Lab.”). Kwality's Lab is 83% full and can't be free, which makes it a reward worth earning; clients on 2+ formats stay longer.

Winback: Beat Your Best (“Remember your best month? Beat it, and we'll pay for the effort.”). Personal data beats a generic offer and turns the reward into attendance, which predicts the next renewal.

Renewal: Early Bird, Golden Ticket (“Anniversary prices, one month early. Plus a golden ticket.”). In 2026 Kwality's March expiries waited for April's 25–31% codes. Near-anniversary prices on longer plans now remove the reason to wait and lift the ticket.
notes:
Moment: International Women's Day (Mon 8 Mar): 'Main Character' class week with a member-nominated 'Main Character of the Month' wall. Anniversary teaser and Golden Envelope Wall reveal from 22 Mar.
Build: new clients 36 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹4.3L; reactivation 32 × ₹11,468 = ₹3.7L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L; renewals ₹14.0L. First visits needed 134; CRM leads needed 167.

keyDates.note: The studio's core audience. Programme the room, not the price.

items.detail: Set up The Second Date in Momence (All March.): A free first Barre class — class 2 free within 7 days (booked at the desk); buy within 72 hours of class 2 for 20% off 1 Month (₹16,191) or a 12-class pack (₹15,750); 10% until day 14.

Set up Earn the Lab in Momence (All March.): Your first 1 Month Unlimited or 12-class pack at the standing 15% (₹17,203 / ₹16,734) — take 3 classes in your first 14 days and unlock a 4-person Strength Lab Induction (normally ₹999) plus one Lab class.
Set up Beat Your Best in Momence (All March.): 1 Month Unlimited at 15% off (₹17,203) or a 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750) — match your personal best month's class count and get +5 days.

Set up Early Bird, Golden Ticket in Momence (All March.): 3 Months at 18% off (₹47,441) or 6 Months at 20% off (₹90,972), for members expiring in March — a reserved pull from April's Golden Envelope Wall and first booking for the anniversary party classes. Staying on 1 Month? Renew at list with +5 days and the golden ticket.
Brief the team on the 4 March offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch The Second Date to First-time clients starting with Barre.
Launch Earn the Lab to New clients in their first 14 days.
Launch Beat Your Best to Lapsed clients with a recorded best month.
Launch Early Bird, Golden Ticket to Members expiring 1–31 March.

Run the month's moment: International Women's Day (Mon 8 Mar): 'Main Character' class week with a member-nominated 'Main Character of the Month' wall. Anniversary teaser and Golden Envelope Wall reveal from 22 Mar.

Weekly check: The Second Date: Second-visit share (target 55%); purchase within 14 days. | Earn the Lab: Inductions unlocked; Lab bookings in month 2. | Beat Your Best: Best-month messages sent; share matching their best. | Early Bird, Golden Ticket: March renewals vs due; golden tickets issued.
Mid-month review against ₹25.0L: by the 15th aim for about half of 135 renewals, 32 reactivations and 36 new buyers (120 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close March: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief April's offers.
From 22 Mar: reveal the Golden Envelope Wall, fill 900 envelopes to the published odds, print Passports to Nine, build the Club Nine seat counter.
